abilities.name: Stealthy Bowshot

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, flowing water will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged torrential arrow will deal Hydro DMG.
Breakthrough
Yelan will enter a "Breakthrough" state after spending 5s out of combat, which will cause her next Charged Aimed Shot to have 80% decreased charge time, and once charged, she can fire a "Breakthrough Barb" that will deal AoE Hydro DMG based on Yelan's Max HP.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.description: N4 has two hits at frames 15 and 29; swap reflects the second hit. Breakthrough Barb (C in Breakthrough state) has its own faster frame profile — listed last in chargeHits so C resolves to it by default. Fully-Charged Aimed Shot is the non-Breakthrough hydro C.
_curatorNotes: chargeHits[1] 'Fully-Charged Aimed Shot' {anim 96, D 86, J 86} (2026-09-17, T1.5): gcsim aimed.go aimedFrames[1] = InitAbilSlice(96) with Dash/Jump at its 86f hitmark. It carried the Breakthrough Barb's 42/32. ⚠️ The frames report pairs this list one entry off — its `chargeHits[0]` row (D 15→86) is the fully-charged shot's slice diffed against our partial shot, which matches gcsim exactly. `C` resolves to the LAST entry, the Barb, so this map is reachable only by the audit today.

abilities.name: Lingering Lifeline

_curatorNotes: C4 (Bait-and-Switch): 10% hp% per marked enemy, max 40%. Modeled at max; per-enemy stacking requires marked-count logic.

abilities.description:
Fires off a Lifeline that allows her to move rapidly, entangling and marking opponents along its path. When the rapid movement ends, the Lifeline explodes, dealing Hydro DMG to marked opponents based on Yelan's Max HP.

Tap: Moves a short distance forward swiftly. Frames reflect tap E.

Hold: Engages continuous swift movement (resistance to interruption increased). Yelan can steer and end the movement early by pressing E again. Duration is player-controlled up to ~3s. gcsim does not yet implement hold E frame data — TODO: model hold E as a variant once KQM data is available.

Each marked opponent on explosion grants Yelan a 34% chance to reset her Breakthrough state.

abilities.name: Depth-Clarion Dice

_curatorNotes: Coordinated attack, authored 2026-08-18. gcsim yelan/yelan.go:61 registers a minazuki.Watcher on action.NormalAttackState with tickerFreq 60 and a 60f ICD key, firing summonExquisiteThrow (burst.go) — THREE darts at burstTravel(20) + i*6, Hydro, Durability 25, ICDTagYelanBurst/ICDGroupYelanBurst. Talent row 'Exquisite Throw DMG' = 8.77% Max HP ×3 at level 10, so `scaling` is ONE dart.

icdGate is gcsim's own ICDGroupYelanBurst verbatim — 120f timer, every 3rd hit applies (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go:127,188). With three darts a wave and waves 1s apart the counter never times out, so exactly one dart per wave applies, which is the kit's claim. ⚠️ docs/coordinated-attacks-survey.md read ICDGroupYelanBreakthrough (18f/every 4) here — that is her CHARGED attack's group, not this one.

C2's extra arrow (2026-09-17, T1.5; was a `manual` damage effect on the C2 entry that reached nothing). gcsim burst.go summonExquisiteThrow: on a wave, if 1.8s have passed since the last one, one more hit — 14% Max HP, ICDTagNone (so it always applies), Durability 25, landing at c2Hitmark = 17f. The Fischl C6 shape: a constellation-gated `whileNormalAttacking` damage effect on the same summon.

interval 2, not 1.8: the arrow rides the WAVE, and waves come every 1s, so the first wave at least 1.8s after the last arrow is two waves later. Under a continuous normal-attack string that is exactly every other wave; after a gap in attacking the two can differ by one wave.

abilities.description:
Deals AoE Hydro DMG and creates an "Exquisite Throw," which aids her in battle.

Exquisite Throw
Follows the character around and will initiate a coordinated attack under the following circumstances, dealing Hydro DMG based on Yelan's Max HP:
· Can occur once every second when your active character uses a Normal Attack.
· Will occur each time Yelan's Lifeline explodes and hits opponents.

passives.name: Turn Control
passives.description: When the party has 1/2/3/4 Elemental Types, Yelan's Max HP is increased by 6%/12%/18%/30%.

passives.name: Adapt With Ease
passives.description:
So long as an Exquisite Throw is in play, your own active character deals 1% more DMG. This increases by a further 3.5% DMG every second. The maximum increase to DMG dealt is 50%.
The pre-existing effect will be dispelled if Depth-Clarion Dice is recast during its duration.

constellations.name: Taking All Comers
constellations.description:
When Exquisite Throw conducts a coordinated attack, it will fire an additional water arrow that will deal 14% of Yelan's Max HP as Hydro DMG.
This effect can trigger once every 1.8s.
_curatorNotes: Authored on the Exquisite Throw summon as a constellation-gated coordinated attack (2026-09-17, T1.5) — see its second effect. The `manual` damage skeleton here drew nothing.

constellations.name: Beware the Trickster's Dice
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Depth-Clarion Dice by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Bait-and-Switch
constellations.description: Increases all party members' Max HP by 10% for 25s for every opponent marked by Lifeline when the Lifeline explodes. A maximum increase of 40% Max HP can be attained in this manner.
constellations.caveat: Shown at its 40% cap. In game it is 10% for each opponent the Lifeline marks.

constellations.name: Dealer's Sleight
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Lingering Lifeline by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Winner Takes All
constellations.description:
After using Depth-Clarion Dice, Yelan will enter the Mastermind state.
In this state, all of Yelan's Normal Attacks will be special Breakthrough Barbs. These Breakthrough Barbs will have similar abilities to normal ones and the DMG dealt will be considered Charged Attack DMG, dealing 156% of a normal Breakthrough Barb's DMG.

The Mastermind state lasts 20s and will be cleared after Yelan fires 5 arrows.
